title: cheilotheca humilis f. glaberrima
intro: Cheilotheca humilis f. glaberrima, commonly known as the glabrous Cheilotheca, is a flowering plant species belonging to the family Gentianaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cheilotheca humilis f. glaberrima include its use as an antimicrobial agent, antipyretic, and antiseptic, making it useful in treating fever, infections, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
